# DigitalCarda

> India's digital business card platform. Create a shareable digital visiting card with QR code, NFC tap, WhatsApp, UPI payment collection, lead capture and analytics — in about two minutes. Starting at ₹99/month with a 30-day free trial and no card details required. Used by 5,173+ Indian professionals — doctors, real-estate agents, jewellers, salons, consultants, restaurants and more.

## About

- Product: Web-based digital business cards (also called digital visiting cards or smart business cards)
- Country: India (all Tier 1, 2 and 3 cities)
- Languages: English, Hindi (multilingual card support with AI translation)
- Contact: +91 9517722444 (call and WhatsApp), hello@digitalcarda.in
- Pricing: ₹99/month starter, ₹499 one-time for NFC printed card, bulk and reseller plans available

- [Home](https://digitalcarda.in/): Product overview and free trial signup

## Key facts

- A digital business card is a shareable web page with your contact details, opened via link or QR code — no app required on either side.
- DigitalCarda cards start at ₹99/month with a 30-day free trial (no card details required).
- NFC printed cards cost ₹499 with free delivery across India.
- The QR code and URL are permanent — redesigning the card never breaks the link.
- 88% of printed paper business cards are thrown away within a week; digital cards live in the recipient's phone.
- Cards support English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Bengali, Punjabi and Kannada with AI translation.
